messages:
Maya: watercooler thought: if our demo LLM had a dating profile, what would its dealbreakers be? be specific. :eyes:
Rohan: 'Cannot handle ambiguous prompts. Will ghost on pronoun resolution.' :anguished:
Ellie: 'Keeps talking about token budgets and never sends pics of its hobbies.' :no_good:
Maya: also must include: does it bring its own laptop to dates? yes/no + emoji.
Rohan: yes ":it prefers quiet compute, brings a manifest of dependencies." :computer:
Ellie: no ":it brings a slide deck and 17 appendices." :page_with_curl:
ops-bot: ops-bot: note: please do not actually bring laptops to the pantry. risk of crumbs in racks. :wrench:
Maya: prompt joke: prompt: `You are an LLM who just discovered irony.` model: "I have learned that when humans say 'be brief', they mean a minimum of 12 paragraphs." :laughing:
Rohan: someone made a tiny heartbreak meme where a model breaks up with a dataset: 'It's not you, it's your distribution shift.' I will never stop laughing. :sob::broken_heart:
Ellie: poll: best anthropomorphized LLM quirk? 1) Overly-earnest intern 2) Dramatic poet 3) Sarcastic code reviewer 4) Grumpy monitor. react with emoji. pick 2.
Maya: voted 2 & 4. can we get stickers? @sticker-chad
sticker-chad: sure — sketching 'Model in therapy' and 'Quantization grief' tonight. will share drafts. :art:
DevBot: DevBot: persona-tests: created persona 'dramatic poet' for demos. contains 3 haikus and one tragic monologue. no production changes. :white_check_mark:
Rohan: follow-up: would you trust the 'dramatic poet' persona to babysit an infra alert? yes/no + one sentence.
Ellie: no — it will write a sonnet about the 503 instead of paging. :page_facing_up:
Maya: code snippet someone dropped earlier: ```prompt
You are a model. Write a short rejection letter to a noisy neighbor dataset.
```
Rohan: actual output: "Dear noisy.csv, your variance keeps me up at night. Sincerely, your overfitted friend." I'm crying. :sob:
ops-bot: ops-bot: reminder: treat models like plants, not roommates. water occasionally, don't let them adopt office pets. :seedling:
Maya: final vote: if our demo LLM could get a tattoo, what would it be? my vote: tiny semicolon on the tokenizer.
Ellie: an error message that says 'I tried' in microprint.
Rohan: closing: someone compile a meme folder. Title: 'LLMs: feelings not included, opinions optional.' :file_folder:
